facts.statement: Permanent insurance premiums tend to be higher than term premiums because of the savings (cash value) element.
facts.quote: Because of the savings element, premiums tend to be higher than term insurance premiums.

items.stem: Why do permanent life policies, such as whole life, tend to cost more than term policies for the same face amount?
options: They include a savings element that builds cash value
They pay a death benefit for a set number of years
They are exempt from state premium taxes
They require a medical exam each year
items.explanation: Per NJ DOBI, Consumer Information: Life Insurance, permanent insurance includes a savings element, so its premiums tend to be higher than term insurance premiums.

facts.statement: Universal life, variable universal life and whole life are all forms of permanent insurance.
facts.quote: Permanent insurance (such as universal life, variable universal life and whole life) provides long-term financial protection.

items.stem: Which of these is NOT a form of permanent life insurance?
items.explanation: Per NJ DOBI, Consumer Information: Life Insurance, universal life, variable universal life and whole life are permanent insurance. Term insurance covers only a set term.
